The differences are:

19 − 2 = 17  
38 − 19 = 19  
74 − 38 = 36 = 17 + 19  
129 − 74 = 55 = 19 + 36  

So the next difference should be:

36 + 55 = 91  

Then:

129 + 91 = 220

<answer>220</answer>
